title: [Chapitre] III. Réseaux via découpages : notes manuscrites (08/06/1986).

errors: The deduction on the page is garbled and partly crossed out. The hypotheses on S and T (disjoint, S ∪ T finite modular, every element modular-finite over S lies in T) are not cleanly stated, and the step 'S ∪ T maximal ⇒ S ∪ T = L' presupposes that L itself is modular. Grothendieck evidently recognised this, since he ends by taking the conclusion as an axiom rather than a theorem.
The claim that S_0 = P_2(L) and that the R_T are discrete is asserted, not derived, from the data on the page. It is a normalisation rather than a consequence.

ideas.what: Axiomatic description of a space/network by its finite 'cuts' T, the components of the complement (equivalence classes R_T) and their frontiers in T
ideas.modern_name: Combinatorial/axiomatic description of connectivity by separating sets (cf. ends of graphs, abstract cell or tame-topology axiomatics, convexity spaces)
ideas.usually_credited_to: various (Freudenthal/Halin for ends via finite separators; combinatorial topology)
ideas.where_published: Spirit of 'tame topology' in Esquisse d'un programme (1984), but not this formalism

ideas.what: Discrete structure as the degenerate example: modular finite parts = all finite subsets, components = points, frontiers empty
Axiom: a maximal finite modular part equals L and forces L discrete

deep.surprise_reason: The page only works out the degenerate discrete example of the axiomatics and turns it into an axiom. The overall 'réseaux via découpages' project is unpublished, but this page holds nothing beyond routine bookkeeping.
transcription_corrections: Line 1: 'vient que si' is probably '[Il] vient que si' or 'veut que si'.
'dans si S et T' should likely read 'donc si S et T'.
'Pour une C générale, on défait la discrétion' is more likely '... on définit [la] discrétion', with an arrow pointing to the 'Ex 1 structure discrète' heading.
'Mod_f(L) = P_f(L)' is written as 'Mod_f(L_0) = P_f(L)' with a correction.
'dans les composantes A ainsi réduites : un pt' should probably read 'donc les composantes A sont réduites à un pt'.
The last line reads: 'Axiome : Si T est partie finie modulaire maximale, alors T = L, L est discrète.'
